<infobox>
  <title source="title1">
    <default>{{PAGENAME}}</default>
  </title>

  <group layout="horizontal">
    <data source="flag">
      <format>{{#if:{{{flag|}}}|[[File:{{{flag}}}|116px|alt=Flag]]}}</format>
    </data>
    <data source="coat_of_arms">
      <format>{{#if:{{{coat_of_arms|}}}|[[File:{{{coat_of_arms}}}|116px|alt=Coat of arms]]}}</format>
    </data>
  </group>

  <image source="map">
    <default>{{{map|}}}</default>
    <caption>Map</caption>
  </image>

  <data source="status"><label>Status</label></data>
  <data source="motto"><label>Motto</label></data>
  <data source="anthem"><label>Anthem</label></data>
  <data source="capital"><label>Capital</label></data>
  <data source="date_established"><label>Date established</label></data>
  <data source="official_language"><label>Official language</label></data>
  <data source="recognized_languages"><label>Recognized national languages</label></data>
  <data source="vernacular_language"><label>Vernacular language</label></data>
  <data source="regional_languages"><label>Regional languages</label></data>
  <data source="minority_languages"><label>Minority languages</label></data>
  <data source="population"><label>Population</label></data>
  <data source="ethnic_groups"><label>Ethnic groups</label></data>
  <data source="religion"><label>Religion</label></data>
  <data source="demonyms"><label>Demonym(s)</label></data>
  <data source="government"><label>Government</label></data>
  <data source="legislature"><label>Legislature</label></data>
  <data source="history"><label>History</label></data>
  <data source="gdp_ppp"><label>GDP (PPP)</label></data>
  <data source="gdp_nominal"><label>GDP (nominal)</label></data>
  <data source="currency"><label>Currency</label></data>
  <data source="controlled_by"><label>Controlled by</label></data>
  <data source="color"><label>Color</label></data>
  <data source="area"><label>Area</label></data>
  <data source="preceded_by"><label>Preceded by</label></data>
  <data source="succeeded_by"><label>Succeeded by</label></data>
</infobox>
